title: Excel and PDF Invoice Generator
subtitle: Sold solution
details: Automated tool for creating invoices in Excel and PDF formats from data extracted from real estate platforms.
The system sorts invoices based on their payment status.

title: Handwritten and Gesture Number Recognition
details: Real-time digit classification using handwritten digits and hand-gesture recognition through live video.
The system uses image processing and machine learning techniques.

title: Bots
details: Intelligent programs in Java and Python using learning protocols (AlphaBeta, Q-Learning, Policy), machine learning, game theory, and Bellman operations to improve decision-making in uncertain situations.

title: Connect Four
details: Connect Four game following the MVC architecture, with AI bots using Minimax and Alpha-Beta pruning.
Five player modes: Minimax Bot, Alpha-Beta Bot, Sorted Alpha-Beta Bot (tested up to depth 12), Random Bot, and Human Player.

title: Quoridor
details: Quoridor game with an AI bot using Q-Learning. The bot learns strategies through exploration and exploitation of game states.
Two player modes: Q-Learner Bot and Human Player.

title: 421 Dice
details: Policy-based learning bot for the 421 dice game. The bot learns by analyzing game states and average values for keep-or-roll decisions.
Three player modes: Policy Bot, Random Bot, and Human Player.

title: Chess
details: Chess game developed in C++ during my Bachelor’s degree, with another two students: pieces, rules, themes, local two-player mode, and a basic AI.

title: Image Generator
details: Python project using OpenAI DALL-E 3 to generate images from text, built to create a LinkedIn banner I own the rights to.
The project was also a way to practice prompt engineering with LLMs.

title: Image Editor
details: Python inpainting and outpainting tool using ComfyUI, tested with open-source models from Hugging Face and CivitAI (Stable Diffusion, Flux, Fooocus).
Used to build and customize image-generation workflows and to go further with prompt engineering.

title: Artificial Intelligence System
details: Multiple AI systems representing a development team, generating functional projects from specifications.
Includes a compiler and automation of development, execution, testing, and verification of generated code.

title: Encoding / Decoding Sensitive Data
details: Java cryptography training project for encrypting and decrypting data with a unique key generated by the program.

title: Modeling a City from a Point Cloud
details: Bachelor’s final project in C++ with CGAL, Qt Creator, and CMake: a point-cloud representation of Lyon from files containing several million points.
Open data was split into more than 1,000 files, geometric functions were tested and rewritten, then meshes were improved and stitched together.

title: Auto Encoder
details: Python and TensorFlow project modeling an AWGN communication channel as an auto-encoder, compared with a traditional M-PSK system.
The work explored whether deep learning could match or outperform established communication methods on this channel.
